ana: deploy-bot just bumped a safety rule on the midnight release: notes mention `--adaptive-cache` but the binary rejects it.

deploy-bot: Safety rule fired: RN-091_release_notes_binary_mismatch. Options: pause+hotfix, full rollback, or emergency flag disable.

ops-marc: Any customer hits?

ana: None reported. CI smoke failed on startup parsing on a canary: `Error: unknown flag adaptive-cache`.

tom: Hotfix preserves telemetry continuity. Rollback faster. What's our SLA risk?

ops-marc: Rollback ~10m; hotfix ~45m. Auto-rollback thresholds not exceeded (errors stable).

docs-rina: If we ship hotfix, update docs and changelog with footnote and link to the revert history.

cs-lee: I'll draft a one-liner for CSMs: "Paused rollout; hotfix underway; monitoring closely."

ana: Plan: pause rollout, pin traffic back to v6.3.9, branch from v6.4.0 tag, reapply handler, tag v6.4.1, smoke, staged promote.

ops-marc: Commands run: `deployctl pause --release v6.4.0` -> paused. `deployctl traffic pin --to v6.3.9 --percent 100` -> pinned.

ana: Hotpatch PR up; staging image OK; smoke test passes. Merged and tagged v6.4.1. Kicking low-ramp rollout.

deploy-bot: Detected v6.4.1; starting staged rollout under policy "minimal-night-ramp". Monitoring startup failures and p95.

tom: Watching dashboards; set a manual kill-switch: `deployctl traffic set --release v6.4.1 --percent 0` if error spike.

deploy-bot: Ramped: 2% -> 20% -> 60%. Metrics stable.

ana: Promoted to 100%. No regressions in 30m. Marking v6.4.1 stable.

ops-marc: Follow-up: add a CI test that parses newly-documented flags against the built binary (ticket RN-092). Also add a changelog gate verifying linked binary artifact.

docs-rina: I'll append the footnote to the changelog.

cs-lee: Internal note posted. Closing thread when stable flag shows.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete: 100% v6.4.1. Stable.
